releaseNotes:
- Settings & Library v2: Dedicated Settings screen, 2x2 Library Bento hub (Albums, Artists, Replay, Radio), Local Music scanner, and unbookmark action for saved YTM playlists
- Zentra Replay: Weekly/Monthly/Yearly/All-Time stats, full-screen auto-advancing Stories, contextual 9:16 HD PNG Share/Save poster, and Top-5 expandable leaderboards
- Live FM & Internet Radio: 4-mirror Radio Browser catalog with Indonesia regional/genre categories & Global (~50k stations) switcher, HLS + ICY live metadata, custom streams, cold-start resume hydration, and 3s+ pause live-edge resync
- Visual & Startup Polish: Dynamic feathered duotone Moods & genres artwork and zero-flash cold-start Dark Mode bootstrap
